name: Ouachita River — McGuire Boating Access to River Bluff
gaugeName: Ouachita River near Mount Ida, AR (USGS 07356000)
blurb: Ouachita River in Arkansas: sections between public Arkansas Game and Fish Commission and U.S. Forest Service accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in McGuire Boating Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Cherry Hill Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
